desc: Derive the fixed-\(k\) DP using only beneficial adjacent forward changes.
Establish that every optimal nonempty good string has a common positive frequency \(k\) among retained letters.
Address omitted letters, the final `'z'`, all-identical strings, already-good strings, and exclusion of the empty result.
Exhaustively compare the implementation with a brute-force solution on small strings and verify the sample outputs.
